3899-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
3899-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-4231-4732-5261-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1651-4231-4732-5261-6441.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

969-2034-3755-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

4221-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4221-5702-7824.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

475-3197-3263-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-3197-3263-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6151.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6151.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

670-1619-5887-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6143.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Feywild Caretaker to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
1123-3967-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

891-2843-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

280-774-5478.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting  Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Golgari Rot Farm's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2033-3490-4460-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
2033-3490-4460-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1636-5914-7179.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with greater mana value than Disruptor of Currents that can be cast using only mana creatures you control can produce.
1636-5914-7179.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Disruptor of Currents.
Cast Disruptor of Currents by paying its mana cost.
When Disruptor of Currents enters the battlefield, it, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Disruptor of Currents trigger, returning the other creature with greater mana value from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast the creature returned to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning Disruptor of Currents from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-5914-7179.notes: You can tap Frogs for mana thanks to Clement. This should be factored in when determining if you have enough mana to execute the combo.

483-2921-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

539-5413-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-5089-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-5089-7013.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

341-2034-3693-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-5241.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Sakashima's Student.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Sakashima's Student by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2173-2292-3845-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4875-4885.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3742-4251-4875-4885.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

222-413-527-4068.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
222-413-527-4068.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1309-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Salvager of Secrets each turn.
1309-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Salvager of Secrets by paying its mana cost.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Salvager of Secrets from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

558-2498-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
558-2498-4691.description:
Activate Carrion Howler by paying 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat as desired.
Resolve all Carrion Howler abilities.

1029-1722-2034-5397.notablePrerequisites: Arcade Gannon does not have summoning sickness.
1029-1722-2034-5397.description:
Activate Arcade Gannon by tapping it, causing you to loot and put a quest counter on it.
Tolarian Kraken and Nadir Kraken trigger.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token and put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap Arcade Gannon.
Repeat.

2292-2633-3440-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Urabrask triggers, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve Demonic Gifts.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

647-1409-2661.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Gwenna.
647-1409-2661.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Gwenna by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Gwenna enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbound ability triggers, repairing it and Gwenna.
Repeat.

2034-2146-3831-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Circuit Mender, adding {C}{C}.
When Circuit Mender dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Circuit Mender on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Circuit Mender trigger, causing you to draw Circuit Mender.
Cast Circuit Mender by paying {2}.
When Circuit Mender enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

913-3430-3793-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
913-3430-3793-4222.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding nine {C}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

876-3492-3609-3854.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Debtors' Knell triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Coretapper.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1912-4009-4331.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1912-4009-4331.description:
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {U}, returning Mox Opal from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mox Opal by paying {0}.
Repeat.

864-2034-4377-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
864-2034-4377-5131.description:
Cast Eternal Witness from your graveyard by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1355-2816.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Sanctum Weaver.
1355-2816.notablePrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three enchantments.
1355-2816.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Sanctum Weaver by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3204-4112-4659.description:
Cast Mysterious Limousine by paying {3}{W}{W}.
Mysterious Limousine enters the battlefield, exiling Sharuum.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mysterious Limousine, adding {C}{C}.
Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield, causing Sharuum to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning Mysterious Limousine from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

575-2363-4489.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker for {X} = 0.
Hangarback Walker dies to having zero toughness.
Yedora and Hangarback Walker trigger.
Resolve the Hangarback Walker trigger, creating zero Thopter tokens.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning Hangarback Walker to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Tap that Forest for {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Hangarback Walker, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

444-2428.notablePrerequisites: A way to draw a card or gain life.
444-2428.description:
Draw a card or gain life.
Whenever you draw a card you gain 1 life.
Whenever you gain life, draw a card.
Repeat.

3542-5175.notablePrerequisites:
"Blue" chosen with Caged Sun.
You control at least six lands that can produce {U}.
3542-5175.description:
Cast Palinchron for {5}{U}{U}.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping at least six lands you control that can produce {U}.
Activate six lands you control by tapping them, adding twelve {U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning Palinchron to your hand.
Repeat.

65-717-2628-4371-4477.description:
Activate Irrigated Farmland's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Irrigated Farmland, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Irrigated Farmland trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Greenwarden of Murasa.
Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, returning Irrigated Farmland from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
